stem: The harlequin ladybird, *Harmonia axyridis*, is an insect that shows discontinuous variation in colour pattern and continuous variation in body size.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Within a species, the variation that is observed for a particular characteristic can be described as discontinuous or continuous.
Discontinuous variation has a different genetic basis from continuous variation.

State **two** differences between discontinuous variation and continuous variation, **other than** having a different genetic basis.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Fig. 9.1 shows three of the colour patterns seen in *H. axyridis* and the percentage of each in a population.

{{figure:figure_9_1.webp}}

Fig. 9.1

Suggest the genetic basis of the variation in colour pattern in *H. axyridis*.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The body size of adult *H. axyridis* varies from $5\text{mm}$ to $8\text{mm}$. Adult ladybirds do **not** grow or change size. Adults develop from larvae that hatch from eggs.

State **two** environmental factors that may affect adult body size in *H. axyridis*.
